name: What is the typical cost to build a backyard guest house in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build a backyard guest house in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a backyard guest house in Southern California can vary significantly based on factors like size, design complexity, finishes, and site preparation. Generally, homeowners can expect costs ranging from $150,000 to over $350,000. This includes architectural plans, permits, construction, and utility hookups. A custom-built unit with high-end finishes will naturally be more expensive than a smaller, more basic design. It's advisable to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project needs and location.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for building a backyard guest house in Southern California range from $150,000 to over $350,000, depending on size, design, and finishes.
